title: Collections Desk Guidance on the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization: Declined Drafts, Retries, Re-presentment and Suspension
content:
The rules the desk applies when a draft under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization does not collect.

**Retries of declined card drafts.** Where the method retries declines, a declined card draft is retried the method's retry interval in calendar days later, up to the method's number of retries for that due date. A retry may be submitted only when the handling date is not earlier than the failed attempt's draft date plus the retry interval. Retry days are calendar days counted from the day after the failed draft date.

*Boundary (hypothetical, 3-day interval).* A card draft declined on the 20th: the counted days are the 21st to the 23rd. A retry on the 23rd may be submitted; a retry on the 22nd may not.

**Re-presentment of ACH returns.** Where the method re-presents, an ACH draft returned for insufficient or uncollected funds is presented again up to the method's number of re-presentments for that entry. Any other return is never presented again.

**Immediate suspension.** A decline or return listed for the method as suspending at once suspends the authorization at once; a draft declined because the card is closed or lost or stolen suspends it for a closed or lost card.

**Suspension after consecutive failures.** Otherwise the authorization is suspended when the count of consecutive failed due dates reaches the method's threshold. The count runs over the authorization's due dates in order up to the handling date, counted back from the latest one until a due date with a successful draft is reached; a due date counts as failed when every draft attempt for it has a result other than approved or ACH settled, or when its settled draft was later returned.

**Status.** Suspension is recorded only for an authorization in active status. A suspended authorization stops drafting.

**Effect on the agreement.** A failed or returned draft leaves the rent unpaid, so late fees and the lien or tow schedule run under the agreement's own rules.

**Notices.** A draft declined for insufficient funds, an expired card, a closed card or a lost or stolen card, or skipped over the draft cap, gives rise to a failed-draft notice to the tenant.

### Consecutive-failure count, worked (hypothetical, threshold of 2)

| Due date | Attempts | Counts as |
|---|---|---|
| March | approved | successful — the count stops here |
| April | declined, retry declined, retry declined | failed |
| May | ACH settled, later returned | failed |

Counted back from May: May failed, April failed, March successful. The count is 2, which reaches a threshold of 2; the authorization, if active, is suspended. With a threshold of 3 the count of 2 has not reached it.
